description: Read-only analytics audit (owner 2026-11-07: see every visitor). On the server: counts public HTML files carrying the own counter /ua/a.js and the Google tag; reads the web app access logs and reduces them to per-day human visitors and how many of them reached the own counter (IP and browser hashed in memory, never saved); reads analytics.db read-only (per-day totals only); asks the Google Analytics Data API for per-day totals (read-only scope). Public: the sitemap pages fetched as a phone, markers only. Temporary always-on task (never the CRM bot). No source, CRM, HTML, media, bot or Google setting change.
title: Site analytics coverage audit
